# github.com/go-again/sqlite

> CGo-free SQLite driver for Go, drop-in replacement for mattn/go-sqlite3,
> modernc.org/sqlite, glebarez/sqlite, and gorm.io/driver/sqlite. Ships
> typed vector search (sqlite-vec) and full-text search (FTS5) sub-packages,
> a gorm dialector, and a read-only fs.FS-as-VFS adapter.

The driver registers under two names so it slots into either ecosystem's
blank imports verbatim: `"sqlite"` (modernc-compatible) and `"sqlite3"`
(mattn-compatible). Same singleton, no behavioural split. Supports the
two most recent Go releases only (the pin is `go.mod`'s `go` directive);
modern syntax is treated as a feature — generics, iter.Seq2, log/slog,
range-over-int, sync.WaitGroup.Go, etc. are all in use.

## Read this first

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): full consumer guide — driver picker, DSN flags, sub-package map, pitfalls, migration recipes, what NOT to do. Read this when integrating the package into a project for the first time.
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing landing page with motivation and Quick start.

## Per-package overviews (pkg.go.dev renders these)

- [doc.go](doc.go): root `package sqlite` — driver registration, hooks, mattn-compat surface.
- [vec/doc.go](vec/doc.go): typed sqlite-vec vector search (`Table`, `KNN`, `Neighbor`, `Row`, `WithFilter`).
- [fts/doc.go](fts/doc.go): typed FTS5 full-text search (`Index[K,V]`, `Hit[K,V]`, query builder, ranking, snippet, highlight).
- Root `sqlite` package: modern Go-typed Config in `config.go` + `open_config.go` — `sqlite.Open(sqlite.Config{Path, Pragmas, Encryption, ...}) (*sqlite.DB, error)`. Backward-compatible with `sql.Open("sqlite", dsn)`.
- [gorm/doc.go](gorm/doc.go): gorm dialector — drop-in for glebarez/sqlite and gorm.io/driver/sqlite. Also exposes `sqlitegorm.OpenConfig(sqlite.Config, ...gorm.Config) (*sqlitegorm.DB, error)` for the modern Go-typed entry.
- [vec/gorm/doc.go](vec/gorm/doc.go): tag-driven sqlite-vec sidecars (`vec:"dim=N;metric=…"`) on gorm models.
- [fts/gorm/doc.go](fts/gorm/doc.go): tag-driven FTS5 sidecars (`fts5:"tokenize=…;external=…;contentless=…"`) on gorm models.
- [vfs/doc.go](vfs/doc.go): expose any `fs.FS` (embed.FS, fstest.MapFS, zip-fs) as a read-only SQLite VFS, plus `vfs.NewReader(io.ReaderAt, size)` for direct-buffer immutable databases without an fs.FS wrapper; and a public user-implementable VFS — implement `vfs.VFS` / `vfs.File` and `vfs.Register(name, impl)` to back a writable database with arbitrary Go storage (rollback-journal by default; WAL via the optional `vfs.ShmFile` capability, where the dispatcher owns the shared memory + lock table and user code only declares a sharing group), embedding `vfs.NoLock` for single-process locking; plus `vfs.Wrap(base, vfs.Recorder)` to instrument any VFS with per-op latency / bytes / errors (`vfs.NewSlogRecorder` for log/slog).
- [vfs/crypto/doc.go](vfs/crypto/doc.go): pure-Go encryption-at-rest VFS — Adiantum / AES-XTS-256, transparent page-level encryption of main DB + journal + WAL + temp files.
- [vfs/cksm/doc.go](vfs/cksm/doc.go): page-level checksum VFS — Fletcher-style trailer on every main-DB page, surfaces silent corruption as SQLITE_IOERR_DATA. Composes with vfs/crypto.
- [vfs/mvcc/doc.go](vfs/mvcc/doc.go): in-memory MVCC VFS — snapshot-isolation reads + atomic publish on commit; shared (`file:/name`) and private (`file:name`) DBs.
- [vfs/memdb/doc.go](vfs/memdb/doc.go): plain in-memory VFS — direct per-page store with no MVCC; smaller-surface alternative to vfs/mvcc for tests and scratch DBs.
- [pcache/doc.go](pcache/doc.go): application-controlled page cache — `pcache.InstallBoundedLRU(maxPages)` swaps SQLite's page cache for a fixed-capacity LRU over C-allocated buffers with hit/miss/eviction/live-page counters; one-time, process-global, install before the first sql.Open. Bounds the heap modernc grows under write load.
- [fusion/doc.go](fusion/doc.go): rank-fusion helpers — combine vec.KNN and fts.Search results via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (Cormack 2009).
- [sqlitex/doc.go](sqlitex/doc.go): ergonomic database/sql helpers (pure Go) — `Save` deferred savepoints, `Transaction` / `ImmediateTransaction`, `ExecScript`, `ResultInt/Text/Float/Bool`, and `Migrate` (embed.FS migration runner tracked via `PRAGMA user_version`). The sqlitex quality-of-life layer for a database/sql driver.
- [ext/README.md](ext/README.md): loadable Go extensions umbrella — opt-in SQL scalar UDFs, table-valued functions, and vtab-based readers. Each sub-package independent; pick by need. Several are Go-native ports of ncruces/go-sqlite3 extensions. See [docs/coverage-ext.md](docs/coverage-ext.md) for the full matrix.
- [ext/spellfix1/spellfix1.go](ext/spellfix1/spellfix1.go): fuzzy-text vtab — Soundex prefilter + Damerau-Levenshtein edit-distance ranking with persistent vocabulary shadow table. Go-native re-implementation of SQLite's spellfix1 (same SQL surface, simpler internals).
- [ext/rtree/rtree.go](ext/rtree/rtree.go): R-Tree spatial index — typed `rtree.Table` (Create / Insert / InsertPoint / Search bounding-box / SearchCircle / Delete / Drop) over the built-in `rtree`/`geopoly` vtabs, plus a ready-made `circle(cx, cy, r)` geometry for `WHERE id MATCH circle(…)`. Built on root `(*Conn).RegisterRTreeGeometry` / `RegisterRTreeQuery`, which wrap `sqlite3_rtree_geometry_callback` / `query_callback` for arbitrary Go geometry/query callbacks.
- [ext/series/series.go](ext/series/series.go): `generate_series(start, stop[, step])` table-valued function — an integer sequence as a SQL table source. start/stop required (stop bounded to avoid a runaway scan), step defaults to 1 and may be negative.
- [ext/text/text.go](ext/text/text.go): rune-aware string scalars SQLite lacks — `text_reverse`, `text_repeat`, `text_lpad`, `text_rpad`, `text_split` (with overflow-safe output-size guards). Casing/normalization stay in `ext/unicode`.
- [ext/fuzzy/fuzzy.go](ext/fuzzy/fuzzy.go): approximate string matching scalars — `levenshtein`, `damerau_levenshtein`, `hamming`, `jaro`, `jaro_winkler`, `soundex`, `caverphone` (2.0). Rune-aware distances; the stateless cousin of the `spellfix1` vtab.
- [ext/encode/encode.go](ext/encode/encode.go): `encode(data, format)` / `decode(text, format)` for base64 / base64url / base32 / base32hex / base16 (hex) / ascii85 / url. The codec half of sqlean `crypto`; digests are `ext/hash`.
- [ext/decimal/decimal.go](ext/decimal/decimal.go): exact base-10 arithmetic scalars over math/big — `decimal_add`/`sub`/`mul`/`div`/`cmp`/`neg`/`abs`/`round`/`floor`/`ceil` + `decimal_sum` aggregate. Inputs TEXT/INT/REAL (REAL read as the shortest round-tripping decimal); any NULL → NULL. Shared `ext/internal/bigdec` backend.
- [ext/money/money.go](ext/money/money.go): fixed 2-dp currency scalars over the same bigdec backend — `money`/`money_add`/`sub`/`mul` + `money_format(x[,symbol])` with thousands separators.
- [ext/time/time.go](ext/time/time.go): Go-time-backed scalars beyond datetime() — `time_now`/`unix`/`from_unix`/`add`/`diff`/`part`/`trunc`/`format` (Go duration + reference-layout syntax). Package name `timeext` (avoids shadowing stdlib); SQL names are `time_*`.
- [ext/eval/eval.go](ext/eval/eval.go): `eval(sql[, sep])` runs dynamic SQL on the calling connection (re-entrant prepared statement) and returns its result values joined by sep. Executes arbitrary SQL — never pass untrusted input; not registered by default.

## Examples (runnable)

- [examples/migrating/from-mattn](examples/migrating/from-mattn/main.go): one-line import swap from mattn/go-sqlite3.
- [examples/migrating/from-modernc](examples/migrating/from-modernc/main.go): one-line import swap from modernc.org/sqlite.
- [examples/migrating/from-glebarez](examples/migrating/from-glebarez/main.go): basic gorm CRUD.
- [examples/features/gorm/vfs](examples/features/gorm/vfs/main.go): gorm reading from a fstest.MapFS via vfs/.
- [examples/features/gorm/vec](examples/features/gorm/vec/main.go): gorm + vec sidecar (side-by-side, no plugin).
- [examples/features/gorm/fts](examples/features/gorm/fts/main.go): gorm + fts external-content (side-by-side, no plugin).
- [examples/features/gorm/vec-tagged](examples/features/gorm/vec-tagged/main.go): tag-driven vec sidecars via vec/gorm plugin.
- [examples/features/gorm/fts-tagged](examples/features/gorm/fts-tagged/main.go): tag-driven FTS5 sidecars via fts/gorm plugin.
- [examples/features/gorm/ext-scalars](examples/features/gorm/ext-scalars/main.go): pair gorm with the scalar / aggregate / collation flavors of ext/ — `regexp`, `uuid`, `hash`, `ipaddr`, `zorder`, `stats`, `unicode` — all auto-registered per conn and driven through plain gorm Where/Order/Select.
- [examples/features/gorm/ext-vtabs](examples/features/gorm/ext-vtabs/main.go): pair gorm with the virtual-table flavors of ext/ — `array` (via `sqlite.Pointer`), `lines`, `csv` (sandboxed via a `Driver.RegisterConnectionHook`), `statement`, `closure`, `bloom`, `spellfix1` — all driven through gorm Exec / Raw / Scan.
- [examples/features/search/vec-search](examples/features/search/vec-search/main.go): raw `vec.Table` API.
- [examples/features/search/fts-search](examples/features/search/fts-search/main.go): raw `fts.Index` API.
- [examples/features/search/fusion-hybrid](examples/features/search/fusion-hybrid/main.go): combine vec.KNN + fts.Search rankings via fusion.RRF2.
- [examples/features/advanced/window-function](examples/features/advanced/window-function/main.go): Conn.RegisterWindowFunction demo.
- [examples/features/vfs/embed](examples/features/vfs/embed/main.go): bundle a `.db` inside `embed.FS`.
- [examples/features/vfs/custom](examples/features/vfs/custom/main.go): implement a writable in-memory VFS on the public `vfs.VFS` / `vfs.File` interface and `vfs.Register` it — full CRUD + transactions through `database/sql`.
- [examples/features/advanced/pcache](examples/features/advanced/pcache/main.go): `pcache.InstallBoundedLRU(32)` then churn a table past the bound — prints hit/miss/eviction/live-page stats showing memory stayed capped.
- [examples/getting-started/config](examples/getting-started/config/main.go): modern Go-typed `sqlite.Config` for plain *sql.DB — plain + encrypted variants, no DSN strings.
- [examples/getting-started/gorm](examples/getting-started/gorm/main.go): same `sqlite.Config` routed through gorm via `sqlitegorm.OpenConfig`.
- [examples/features/vfs/crypto](examples/features/vfs/crypto/main.go): encryption at rest via vfs/crypto (Adiantum / AES-XTS-256, pure Go).
- [examples/features/gorm/crypto](examples/features/gorm/crypto/main.go): gorm + vfs/crypto + vec/gorm + fts/gorm + fusion — encrypted DB with embedding sidecars, FTS5 search, hybrid ranking via RRF, argon2id key derivation, slog Recorder, WAL + busy_timeout.
- [examples/features/extensions/array](examples/features/extensions/array/main.go): bind a Go slice as a SQL table via the `ext/array` eponymous vtab; shows explicit `array.Register` + `array.Bind` and the blank-import auto path; JOINs the array against a normal table to demonstrate composition.
- [examples/features/extensions/regexp](examples/features/extensions/regexp/main.go): REGEXP operator + regexp_substr / regexp_replace over a small users table.
- [examples/features/extensions/uuid](examples/features/extensions/uuid/main.go): generate v1/v4/v6/v7 + name-based v5; parse + reformat round-trip via uuid_str/uuid_blob.
- [examples/features/extensions/hash](examples/features/extensions/hash/main.go): md5/sha1/sha2/sha3/blake2b digests + sha3 size variants.
- [examples/features/extensions/ipaddr](examples/features/extensions/ipaddr/main.go): ipcontains/ipfamily/ipnetwork over an events table with mixed IPv4 / IPv6 sources.
- [examples/features/extensions/zorder](examples/features/extensions/zorder/main.go): 2D Morton encoding round-trip + locality property demo.
- [examples/features/extensions/stats](examples/features/extensions/stats/main.go): PostgreSQL-style aggregates (variance, percentile, regr_*, median, mode, every) plus a windowed regr_slope demo over a small employees table.
- [examples/features/extensions/unicode](examples/features/extensions/unicode/main.go): Unicode-aware case mapping (with locale-tagged forms for Turkish / German), normalize, unaccent, NOCASE_UNICODE / NOCASE_ACCENT preset collations, plus a Swedish-locale collation that sorts `å` after `z`.
- [examples/features/extensions/csv](examples/features/extensions/csv/main.go): read CSV files as SQL tables via the typed `csv.Table` API (Create / Columns / Rows / Name) — `Create` hides the `USING csv(…)` argument string and its quoting. Shows GROUP BY + SUM and a JOIN across two CSV files sandboxed in an `fstest.MapFS`.
- [examples/features/extensions/blobio](examples/features/extensions/blobio/main.go): stream `zeroblob(N)` allocations via `readblob` / `writeblob`, and the same data through the typed `(*Conn).OpenBlob` API.
- [examples/features/extensions/bloom](examples/features/extensions/bloom/main.go): probabilistic set-membership via the typed `bloom.Filter` API (Create / AddMany / Contains) with a tunable false-positive rate.
- [examples/features/extensions/fileio](examples/features/extensions/fileio/main.go): walk a sandboxed `fstest.MapFS` via `fsdir`, `readfile`-it through SQL, and confirm `writefile` is unavailable in sandbox mode.
- [examples/features/extensions/statement](examples/features/extensions/statement/main.go): parametrized views — anonymous `?N` and named `:pat` binds exposed as HIDDEN columns.
- [examples/features/extensions/pivot](examples/features/extensions/pivot/main.go): three-SELECT cross-tab (rows × columns × cell aggregate) over a small sales table.
- [examples/features/extensions/closure](examples/features/extensions/closure/main.go): parent-child graph walks via the typed `closure.Graph` API — descendants, depth bounds (`WithMaxDepth`), and ancestor walks via `Reversed`.
- [examples/features/extensions/lines](examples/features/extensions/lines/main.go): read a log file as one-row-per-line via the typed `lines.Table` API (Create / Columns / Rows / Name), then filter ERROR lines and aggregate by severity with plain SQL over the vtab.
- [examples/features/extensions/rtree](examples/features/extensions/rtree/main.go): spatial index via the typed `rtree.Table` API — Create a 2D R-Tree, InsertPoint several venues, then a bounding-box Search and a SearchCircle radius query (circle geometry wired by blank-importing `ext/rtree/auto`).
- [examples/features/vfs/cksm](examples/features/vfs/cksm/main.go): detect simulated bit-rot via the checksum VFS — corrupt one byte, observe `SQLITE_IOERR_DATA` on read.
- [examples/features/vfs/mvcc](examples/features/vfs/mvcc/main.go): SHARED (`file:/name`) vs PRIVATE (`file:name`) in-memory MVCC databases; reader / writer concurrency demo.
- [examples/features/vfs/memdb](examples/features/vfs/memdb/main.go): same shared / private shape as vfs-mvcc but on the simpler `vfs/memdb` VFS — writes are visible immediately, no snapshot isolation.
- [examples/features/advanced/hooks](examples/features/advanced/hooks/main.go): install update / authorizer / commit / trace hooks on a pinned connection (MaxOpenConns(1) + db.Conn + sc.Raw idiom).
- [examples/features/advanced/backup](examples/features/advanced/backup/main.go): `(*Conn).Backup` mattn-compat factory + top-level `sqlite.Serialize` / `sqlite.Deserialize` round-trip.
- [examples/features/advanced/session](examples/features/advanced/session/main.go): SESSION extension — record changes on a primary database into a changeset (`(*Conn).CreateSession` → `*Session.Changeset`), replay onto a replica with `(*Conn).ApplyChangeset`, then undo via `InvertChangeset`. The offline-sync / replication primitive, pure Go.
- [examples/features/extensions/spellfix1](examples/features/extensions/spellfix1/main.go): fuzzy spell-correction via the typed `spellfix1.Vocab` API (Create / AddMany / Correct / CorrectSQL), Soundex prefilter + Damerau-Levenshtein scoring.

## Feature coverage matrices

- [docs/coverage-sql.md](docs/coverage-sql.md): SQLite raw-SQL surface (SELECT clauses, joins, CTEs, windows, JSON1, datetime, constraints, triggers, UPSERT, RETURNING, PRAGMA).
- [docs/coverage-vec.md](docs/coverage-vec.md): every documented sqlite-vec feature with status (typed / raw / inherited).
- [docs/coverage-fts.md](docs/coverage-fts.md): every FTS5 feature with status.
- [docs/coverage-gorm.md](docs/coverage-gorm.md): every gorm.Dialector / Migrator / ErrorTranslator method with status.
- [docs/coverage-ext.md](docs/coverage-ext.md): every `ext/` loadable extension with status (✓ landed / ⚠ partial / ✗ deferred / ✗ skipped), upstream reference, and the test pin. Includes the per-extension scaffolding checklist.
- [docs/coverage-vfs.md](docs/coverage-vfs.md): every `vfs/` sub-package (root fs.FS adapter + `vfs.NewReader` + the user-implementable `vfs.Register` interface, crypto, cksm, mvcc, memdb) with status, upstream reference, and the test pin. Includes the per-VFS scaffolding checklist.
